references.context: Open the stage curtain with controlled hits.
references.label: Stage curtain
references.description: Center stage entrance opened to start Stage modes.

references.context: Use a clean Stage Alley entry when its feed is controlled.
references.label: Stage Alley
references.description: Stage-entry lane whose clean route can start a Stage mode at 2x.

references.context: Use the right inner loop for Trunk locks.
references.label: Trunk lock loop
references.description: Inner loop used to catapult balls into the trunk locks.

references.context: Use the Milkcan loop before the ramp.
references.label: Milkcan loop
references.description: Loop used before the ramp to build the timed multiplier.

references.context: Test the Magic target area during ball save.
references.label: Magic targets
references.description: Target area associated with the game's playfield magnets.

references.context: Start the next Secret Mission at the scoop.
references.label: Secret Mission scoop
references.description: Scoop used for Secret Mission starts and other awards.
